# v1.4.0 - Radial Menu Snap Alignment, Configurable News Panel, Settings UX

## English
- Fixed: when snapped to screen edge, the floating widget is now temporarily re-centered to the radial menu ring center; it restores after the menu closes.
- AI news panel: width / height / font size are now configurable in Settings (default 860x680, 13px); auto-generated reports (startup & daily) automatically open the panel (can be disabled); the panel is placed near the floating widget.
- Settings style unified: API usage and AI news pages no longer have separate outer borders; interest topics are all shown flat (no inner scroll) and use theme colors in both light/dark (fixed black box/border).
- Settings buttons: Apply now applies and closes; Save is only enabled when something changed and shows a change-summary toast before closing.
- New config: news.panel_width / panel_height / font_size (falls back to defaults for old configs).
notes_zh:
# v1.4.0 - 环绕菜单吸附对齐 + 快报面板可配置 + 设置交互优化

## 中文
- 修复：吸边状态下展开环绕菜单，浮窗不再偏离圆环中心——展开时按屏幕钳制后的环心临时平移浮窗，菜单关闭后自动恢复吸附位置。
- AI 快报面板：可在设置中调整窗口宽度 / 高度 / 正文字号（默认 860×680、13px）；启动补生成与每日定时生成完成后自动弹出快报窗口（可在设置关闭）；面板自动放置在浮窗附近。
- 设置页统一风格：API 用量与 AI 快报页去掉独立外边框与其他模块一致；关注主题全部平铺显示（不再内部滚动），浅色/深色主题均使用主题配色（修复黑框黑底）。
- 设置按钮逻辑：「应用」立即生效并关闭设置窗口；「保存」仅在设置被修改后可用（未修改置灰），保存后弹出本次修改内容摘要 toast。
- 新增配置 `news.panel_width / panel_height / font_size`（旧配置缺省自动回退）。
